dict.string: Mi Band watch face or app
My Band uses Bluetooth to connect to your Mi Band 10 and sync activity and sleep data in the background.
My Band sends your upcoming calendar events to your Mi Band 10 so you can see them on your wrist.
My Band sends your upcoming calendar events to your Mi Band 10 so you can see them on your wrist.
My Band reads existing samples in Apple Health to avoid writing duplicate data from your Mi Band 10.
My Band writes the data synced from your Mi Band 10 to Apple Health: sleep, heart rate (including resting), steps, SpO₂, calories, distance, body temperature, VO₂ max, and workouts with GPS routes.

Allow "Always" so your Mi Band 10 keeps receiving the iPhone's GPS while the screen is locked or the app is in the background during an outdoor workout. Without it, the band loses the GPS signal as soon as you put your phone in your pocket.

My Band uses your location to send your Mi Band 10 the weather forecast for where you are and, during outdoor workouts, the GPS route.
My Band sends your reminders with due dates to your Mi Band 10 so the band can alert you at the right time.
